why.title: Be a founding partner
why.text: This is the first edition. Founding partners are written into KILF’s story from page one.

why.title: A rare audience
why.text: Readers, students, families and creators, gathered for five days in one place.

why.title: Own New Year’s Eve
why.text: The midnight chapter by the lake: the moment everyone remembers, and shares.

why.title: A lasting cause
why.text: Reading culture, young voices and a protected lake. Support that outlives the festival.

tiers.name: Title Partner
tiers.text: The festival carries your name. Maximum visibility across every touchpoint.

tiers.name: Presenting Partner
tiers.text: Presented-by credit, stage presence and a signature moment.

tiers.name: Associate Partner
tiers.text: Strong visibility across venues, print and digital.

tiers.name: Category Partners
tiers.text: Own a category: hospitality, travel, banking, education and more.
